Two Busts of Cardinal Scipione Borghese.question: Bernini was notified and immediately set to work to create a second version with a new block of marble, which took three days according to _____, and fifteen to Baldinucci
Two Busts of Cardinal Scipione Borghese.fact: Bernini was notified and immediately set to work to create a second version with a new block of marble, which took three days according to Domenico Bernini, and fifteen to Baldinucci. According to Domenico Bernini, Cardinal Borghese saw the unpolished version and was so impressed he asked that the bust be completed and be shown to his uncle, Pope Paul V.
